intro: During Hallow's End, Gnomeregan Gumdrops reach travelers from the exiled gnomes. One sweet helps sick Jesper celebrate at the Stormwind orphanage.

p: At Ironforge's Mystic Ward, Talvash del Kissel hands out Gnomeregan Gumdrops to travelers who play along with his Hallow's End tricks. Innkeepers across the Alliance offer regional treats, but the exiled gnomes have no capital inn of their own. The radioactive disaster drove them from their underground kingdom, yet they still share their distinct sweets with the Alliance.

Sick Jesper is confined to the Stormwind orphanage in Cathedral Square and cannot travel the continents to trick-or-treat. Travelers gather four regional sweets from Alliance capitals to bring the holiday to him: Gnomeregan Gumdrop, Stormwind Nougat, Ironforge Mint, and Darnassus Marzipan.
